message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features "TEMPO" in large white letters across the top. Below, the text "GEDABRUS OMNIBUS" is printed in large, black, sans-serif font. Further text in Indonesian follows. A red band runs down the left edge.

The central illustration depicts a stylized, brown-skinned human figure in a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. The figure is captured in mid-stride, walking away from a large yellow bulldozer towards the left. The figure is kicking a red carpet that rolls out across a dry, grassy landscape. The bulldozer, positioned on the right, has a massive, metallic grey blade resting on the ground, nearly touching the red carpet. A thin trail of grey smoke rises from the bulldozer’s exhaust pipe into a beige sky.

In the lower right corner, white text includes "27 JANUARI-2 FEBRUARI 2020," price information, a website, and a barcode. Additional headlines at the top read "DI BALIK PEMECATAN DIREKTUR UTAMA TVRI" and "JEJARING EKSPOR SIRIP HIU LANGKA." The landscape is a flat, pale-brown field.
